interview.name: Noah
interview.answer: The repair drive is being held by the community hall, but the exact time isn’t stated in the notes.

reflections: Noah is willing to help and promote the repair drive, even when details are still being clarified.
Rey and Hana are both cooperative coordinators who prefer to confirm specifics before moving forward.
The group communicates constructively around a small community effort, with shared intent to help neighbors.
Noah is consistently proactive and cooperative, often volunteering to help once he has the latest details.
Rey, Hana, Jules, and Dane coordinate by passing along status updates and dividing tasks, suggesting a practical, collaborative group dynamic.
There is mild uncertainty around shared details, but the group handles it by checking inventory, confirming needs, and keeping communication open.
Noah is reliably supportive and tends to coordinate by waiting for details, checking inventory, and helping spread the word.
Hana and Uli both prefer to act once the right information is available, and they rely on Noah for follow-through and coordination.
The group is organizing practical volunteer work around donations, repair-drive details, and table sorting, with some requests to keep plans quiet for now.
Noah is eager to help but often lacks the latest repair drive details and needs clearer updates.
Uli is coordinating quietly and values practical support with sorting and heavy lifting.
The group is generally cooperative and responsive, with people offering to fill gaps once they know what is needed.
Noah is consistently helpful but under-informed, relying on others for the latest repair drive details.
The repair drive has active, growing participation, with multiple people offering specific help like sorting, tools, and spreading the word.
The group coordinates through quick back-and-forth updates, and people are willing to step in once they know the current plan.

events.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? Right — I might’ve missed the latest details, but I’m happy to help if you fill me in.
events.speaker: Noah

events.text: Rey: Thanks, Noah — it’s just a small neighborhood repair drive to help folks with minor fixes. I can tell you the details if you want to jump in.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Noah: I’m going to spread the word about the repair drive and see who can pitch in.

events.text: Noah: Thanks, Jules — I appreciate it. Just send me the latest details when you have them, and I’ll help spread the word.

events.text: Noah: Absolutely — I’ll check the inventory and send you the latest details as soon as I have them.

events.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? I might’ve missed the latest details again, but I’m happy to help once you fill me in.

events.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I heard folks are still dropping things off by the community hall — seems like it’s picking up nicely.
events.speaker: Tess

events.text: Noah: Oh, that’s great to hear — I’m glad it’s picking up. I’ll spread the word and see who else can pitch in.
events.speaker: Noah

events.text: Gus: Yep, I’m still in for the repair drive—just point me to the first fix and I’ll bring the tools.
events.speaker: Gus

prov.value: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
